_comment: Ground truth: what a human confirmed is printed on each photograph.
This is NOT the baseline. tests/fixtures/accuracy_baseline.json holds what
the code currently produces; this file holds what is actually correct, and
the two must never be merged - see tools/accuracy.py.
header: a key present with value null means VERIFIED ABSENT. A key that is
missing means nobody checked that field, and it is not scored.
lines: null means not transcribed yet, which is not an empty receipt.
sha256: the photograph this record describes. If the image changes, the
harness says so instead of scoring against the wrong paper.
No card number, address or transaction code appears here, and the
photographs themselves stay out of git.

Walmart1.jpg.note: Photographed with the top out of frame, so merchant and date are verified ABSENT rather than unchecked. Transcription is shared with tests/test_real_receipt.py and self-checks four ways.
